name: ankiconnect
description: Anki for Claude: the mcp-ankiconnect server (review, add, search, edit, flag, reschedule) plus skills for writing cards, judging card quality and redesigning bad cards in bulk.

ankiconnect_url.title: AnkiConnect URL
ankiconnect_url.description: Where the AnkiConnect add-on listens. Change it only if you moved AnkiConnect off the default port.

auto_launch_anki.title: Open Anki automatically
auto_launch_anki.description: When a tool needs Anki and it is closed, open Anki in the background and carry on. Turn off to get an error instead.
